record.what_it_does: Close is a sales-focused CRM (calling, email, SMS, pipelines, workflows) with a REST API for managing leads, contacts, opportunities, tasks, and sales activity.
record.auth_notes: API keys use HTTP Basic auth (key as username, blank password) and are recommended for internal scripts; OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow is recommended for user-facing/marketplace integrations and requires registering an OAuth app in Close developer settings. The MCP server also accepts API-key auth via Close-API-Key/Close-Scope headers, or OAuth 2.0 Dynamic Client Registration.
record.access_notes: Sign-up gives a 14-day free trial with no credit card required, and API access (with an event log API) is listed as a feature on every paid plan starting at Solo ($9-19/user/mo). There is no perpetual free tier — ongoing API use requires converting to a paid subscription after the trial.
record.main_blocker: No perpetual free tier — full ongoing API access requires a paid subscription after the 14-day trial

evidence.quote: API Keys — Best for scripts, internal tools, and server-side integrations. Use HTTP Basic Auth... OAuth 2.0 — Best for user-facing integrations.
API keys use HTTP Basic client side authentication.
Try Close free for 14 Days... No credit card. No contracts.
API access + event log API... Connect your Close organization using API keys of using OAuth access.
Close uses industry-standard REST conventions with predictable URL structures, standard HTTP methods, and JSON request/response bodies.
The MCP server URL is `https://mcp.close.com/mcp` and has "HTTP Streamable" and "OAuth 2.0 Dynamic Client Registration (DCR)" support.
Webhooks — Subscribe to events and receive POST notifications when data changes.
We publish an OpenAPI spec at: https://api.close.com/api/openapi.json
